npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-001.h.text: Newbie Guide: Do not hesitate to ask me if you need advice! I'll give you what help I can.

links.text: Ask about teleporting to Newbie Town.
Check the list of available Support Magic.
Get support with a Newbie item.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-002.h.text: Newbie Guide: You have progressed well in our art. I think you can best advance further without my counsel. As a Dark Elf, you must always look first to your own heart for guidance.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-003.h.text: Newbie Guide: I only teach Dark Elves; there is nothing here for any other race. Leave now!

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-04.ht.text: Newbie Guide: Which of the following best describes the one you seek?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-05.ht.text: Newbie Guide: To find the person you seek, just follow the arrow about your head.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f05-0.text: Newbie Guide: Always keep your mind fixed on the ultimate goal! War has brought chaos to the realms of Men, and chaos is our natural element. We seek to make use of this chaos to advance our race and bury the sun dwellers. But first things first. Begin by mastering the weapons and armor you have no…

Newbie Guide: If you have powerful companions, they may Buy Equipment for you. Otherwise, equipment for novices is provided by the Shilen Temple. For now, you should seek to master the arms and armor you already possess. You will sometimes obtain arms and armor from the monsters you hunt. With some…

Newbie Guide: For now, you should hunt keltirs , elder keltirs , or wolves near the village. Wolves are the most dangerous, so take care. When you target a monster, the monster's name appears in the upper central portion of the screen. The color of the name tells you the monster's difficulty . For …

Newbie Guide: You may begin to learn skills when you reach level 5. Training in skills may be obtained at the Shilen Temple, where the masters and elders stay. The Temple is the largest building in the village, north of the village square. The masters there will teach you. First, however, you will …

links.text: I want to know more about skills.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f05-0.text: Newbie Guide: If you speak with Master Harant or Master Trudy , they will show you the list of skills and magic you are eligible learn. There are two kinds of skills: active and passive. An active skill is something you can use yourself. A passive skill can't be directly used, but once learned it r…

Newbie Guide: There are many here in the village who could benefit from your services. Speak to them to find those who wish to offer employment. They will offer you an assignment when you click on Quest . They will not ask you to perform a quest which is beyond your abilities, so if they refuse to …

links.text: I want to know more about the quests.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f05-0.text: Newbie Guide: I am pleased to tell you what I know, but I do not know everything. You should speak to as many of the villagers as you can. Have you already spoken to Abyssal Celebrant Undrias at the gate of the Shilen Temple? He may want to ask a favor of you. Also, seek out Sentry Nelsya at the no…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f05.h.text: Newbie Guide: What guidance can I offer you? There is much you must learn before you can be counted among the great heroes of our race.

links.text: What is the best equipment for me?
What is the best hunting site for me?
Which quests are available to me?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f10-0.text: Newbie Guide: I advise you now to begin explorations of our own Dark Forest. If you've only hunted around the village so far, you should begin to venture into the southern regions of the forest . When you attain Level 10 you must look for Tetrarch Thifiell . The Tetrarch may request that you perfor…

Newbie Guide: At Level 6, your most important task is to find better weapons. Consider the weapon you are wielding now, then think how you wish to improve it. If you prefer to wield a dagger, seek to obtain a Bone Dagger . A doomed dagger is even better, but will be quite expensive. A Bone Dagger w…

links.text: I want to know about the characteristics of each weapon type.
I want to know about armor.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f10-0.text: Newbie Guide: Weapons are classified into seven categories. They are: one-handed swords, blunt weapons, two-handed blunt weapons and two-handed swords, daggers, polearms, fists and bows. I can offer you guidance about swords, blunt weapons, daggers and bows.

Newbie Guide: One-handed swords are the most common weapons. Their abilities are well balanced in every way. The Squire's Sword you began your adventures with was one of these. If you are unsure which weapon would be best for you, a one-handed sword is always a suitable choice. You may use the Powe…

Newbie Guide: One-handed blunt weapons have a higher accuracy than other weapons. However, their chance to inflict critical damage is much lower. Blunt weapons are designed to reliably deal predictable amounts of damage . I recommend these weapons to Mystics, who do not have the training to be high…

Newbie Guide: Two-handed swords and two-handed blunt weapons tell the world that a warrior possesses formidable power. It stands to reason that wielding your weapon with both arms would deal more powerful strokes, and also extend the weapon's reach. The drawback is that the attack speed of two-hand…

Newbie Guide: Dagger type weapons allow you to attack with unsurpassed speed. Furthermore, they have the greatest chance of inflicting critical damage. Their accuracy is low, however, and of course their reach is quite short. Daggers also have a very small range of random damage. However, in combin…

Newbie Guide: Obviously, the advantage of bows is their ability to deliver damage at range. There is more, though, that you should know. Bows are the slowest weapons, but they can inflict the greatest damage. A popular tactic is to open combat with a Power Shot , before you close to attack with you…

Newbie Guide: If you have been fortunate in your adventures, you should be able to improve your armor. You should consider saving your money to upgrade your armor piece by piece. If you've reached Level 6, you can wear Apprentice's Shoes, Cloth Caps and Short Gloves with your armor. If you are part…

Newbie Guide: I believe Balor Orcs and walking fungi are suitable prey for your skills. They can easily be found in the south reaches of the Dark Forest. Which reminds me, you must soon complete the Orc Subjugation quest given by Sentry Kayleen. You will gain valuable experience hunting Orcs. Be ve…

Newbie Guide: What are the offensive skills that you are using already? Once you choose a skill, it is better to concentrate on developing that skill, than on acquiring new ones. After Level 10, you may increase your skills. Upgrade the ones you already use most. As a rule, after you increase an of…

Newbie Guide: Listen carefully -- there are two important tasks that you must soon complete. Seek out Tetrarch Thifiell when you reach Level 10. He has an important quest to give you. Also, you must find Sentry Kayleen in the southern reaches. She is recruiting volunteers for an Orc Subjugation que…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f10.h.text: Newbie Guide: My word, your progress so far has been most satisfactory. However, you have not yet been called upon to use your brain a great deal. From now on it will take wisdom and cunning to survive. In particular, you must make wise choices when it comes to your equipment and skills. Pay attent…

links.text: What is the best equipment for me?
What is the best hunting site for me?
Which quests are available to me?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f15-0.text: Newbie Guide: Now is the time you should begin to consider your choice of a higher-level occupation. Although you will not actually select your occupation until Level 19, it is a good idea to begin preparing for that choice. The most important thing you must do to prepare is to gain experience adve…

links.text: I want to know about fighting in groups.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f15-0.text: Newbie Guide: It is time to discuss forming a party , a group of adventurers to hunt and travel with. Parties are created using Invite in the Action tab ( ALT + C ) of your Character Status window. First, click on the person you wish to invite into your party, then click the Invite icon. When you n…

links.text: I want to fight on my own.
I want to fight in groups.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f15-0.text: Newbie Guide: I see. You have chosen a difficult path, though it does have its rewards. If you wish to hunt solo, there are things you need to know. First, there's the matter of timing your battles while on the hunt. As you increase in level, you will need more and more time to rest between battles…

Newbie Guide: It requires serious preparation to be an effective member of a group. Experience is the best teacher, but I can tell you some of the basics. First, for now it matters little whether you hunt with other Fighters or with Mystics. The most important thing right now is that you find peopl…

Newbie Guide: So far, it's likely that you have gotten by mostly with weapons found while adventuring. But now, as you approach level 15, you may find that relying on found weapons is holding you back. To obtain the best weapons for yourself, you should seek out other adventurers willing to trade. …

links.text: I want to hear about weapons.
I want to hear about armor.
I want to hear about items.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f15-0.text: Newbie Guide: Have you considered the next weapon you wish to purchase? Broadswords are mere children's toys to you now. At Level 12 or 13 the Gladius is an excellent choice for a sword, the dirk for a dagger, and the Dwarven Mace for a blunt weapon. You can find these weapons in stores, but they a…

Newbie Guide: At your current level, a Wooden Breastplate and a Hard Leather Pants set are an effective combination. Leather Shoes, a Wooden Helmet and gloves should be sought to complete your kit. Of course, you will not be able to equip all this equipment immediately at Level 11, but you can star…

Newbie Guide: It's time for you to learn about magic items. I'm sure that by now you've used lesser healing, but there's far more that you must know about if you plan to survive. It is time that you began to acquire accessories . This is the general term for items that increase your magic defense. …

Newbie Guide: For adventurers of your level, the Marshlands , south of the village, are very popular hunting grounds, as is the area around the School of Dark Arts . You can effectively increase your level by defeating marsh zombies or skeleton hunters . One rule that always holds true -- the farth…

Newbie Guide: The time has come to teach you specific tactical applications for your skills. First, you must understand the technique for canceling magic . When you hunt marsh zombies, for example, you will notice that they sometimes give up on a spell they are casting when they take damage. This i…

Newbie Guide: Have you completed your mission for Tetrarch Thifiell yet? It is very important that you complete this task. You should also see Blacksmith Karrod . I suspect he has troubles that need to be dealt with. I'm sure that if you aid him, he'll be most generous. Look up Trader Minaless as w…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f15.h.text: Newbie Guide: You continue to improve. Now that you have mastered the perils of the Dark Forest, you will find that my instruction is quite different than it was. It is now time for you to learn about cooperating with others . This is a turning point in your career. Until you reached Level 10, all …

links.text: What is the best equipment for me?

Which quests are available to me?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f20-0.text: Newbie Guide: As I've already explained, your choice of professional path is of great importance. The whole course of your future rests on this choice. If you wish, I can explain what is involved when you select an occupation.

links.text: I want to know about the occupations available to me.
I want to know how to change occupations.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f20-0.text: Newbie Guide: As a Dark Fighter, you may elect to become either a Palus Knight or an Assassin . Regardless of which occupation you select, you must depart these woods for the Human region of Gludio. I advise you to speak to Tetrarch Thifiell for further information. He will examine your qualificati…

Newbie Guide: You must journey to the Kingdom of Aden to assume your new profession. You can obtain training in Gludin or the Town of Gludio . There is no more for you to learn here, in the land of your birth. Ask Tetrarch Thifiell , at the Shilen Temple, for further instruction. There are two ways…

Newbie Guide: There isn't much left to teach you about items. I'll explain as much as I can in the time that remains. Some of the information may seem complex, but you must comprehend it if you are to choose the correct occupation. Where shall we begin?

links.text: I want to know about recommended weapons.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f20-0.text: Newbie Guide: If you have chosen to wield a one-handed sword, then by now you must at least possess a long sword . If luck is with you, you may happen across a Sword of Reflection or a Sword of Watershadow . Both are quite similar to a long sword, so either will suit your purposes. A draw knife is …

Newbie Guide: Upper and lower body armor is classified as either robes , light gear or heavy gear . Robes are for Mystics and that ilk, so we'll skip them and move directly to light and heavy gear. When you select your occupation at Level 20, the armor you wear will influence your choice of skills.…

Newbie Guide: Have you encountered soulshot yet in your adventures? You've heard me use the term before. It is a form of magical ammunition created by the Dwarves. You can use soulshot like potions while engaged in armed combat. They allow you to inflict greater damage, but they disappear when used…

Newbie Guide: Through their arts, the Dwarven craftsmen can crystallize certain substances into Leaguam, Ravi, Ciel and Arch through a process they call the "Crystallization Ritual." These craftsmen have assigned grades to every substance in the world, according to the types of crystal they form du…

Newbie Guide: By now, you should be able to hunt anywhere in the forest. I imagine that giant spiders and dark horrors are your primary targets. You can find many of these in the deep southern regions of the forest. Remember what I told you -- if travel time is becoming a nuisance, teleport through…

Newbie Guide: You must refine your profession at level 20. If you do not, there is nothing more that you can be taught here. Only after you select your professional path can you go on to learn new skills. If you choose to become a Palus Knight, for example, you can learn skills such as Defense Auro…

Newbie Guide: Seek out Tetrarch Thallos as soon as you can. He is trying to free Hierarch Mitraell, but it has come to my attention that he does not yet possess all the necessary materials. I'm sure he'll reward you for your assistance. If you're already hunting giant spiders, then you should certa…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-f20.h.text: Newbie Guide: There is nothing more that our forest can teach you. Now you must focus on choosing your occupation. Will you elect the path of the Palus Knight, which balances offensive and defensive capability? Or do you accept the life of an Assassin, with all its unique arts of bow and dagger?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-m07-0.text: Newbie Guide: Always keep your mind fixed on the ultimate goal! War has brought chaos to the realms of Men, and chaos is our natural element. We seek to make use of this chaos to advance our race and bring down the sun dwellers. But first things first. Begin by mastering the weapons and armor you h…

Newbie Guide: The apprentice's staff is effective until Level 5 or so. Try to save around 1,000 Adena by then, so you can purchase an Apprentice's Rod . You can make use of the armor you obtain from monsters, of course, but this depends entirely on luck. If you've reached Level 5 and you do not yet…

Newbie Guide: Listen closely -- this is very important knowledge for a Dark Mystic like yourself. Armor is divided into robes, light armor and heavy armor. Dark Mystics may wear armor of any type, but different types of armor will affect your abilities differently. When I refer to a set of armor, i…

Newbie Guide: Try hunting imps, ashen wolves or goblins near the village. Your spells are your most powerful attacks, so look for monsters you can defeat with a single spell until you reach at least level 3. After level 6, go southwest and challenge Balor Orcs or walking fungi . An important rule o…

links.text: How do you determine a monster's strength?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-m07-0.text: Newbie Guide: When you target a monster, the monster's name appears in the upper central portion of the screen. The color of the name tells you the monster's difficulty. Those that appear in white or sky blue have abilities equal or less than yours, while those that appear in red or yellow are stro…

Newbie Guide: A Dark Mystic must pay close attention to both current HP and current MP. Make sure you have enough of both before entering combat. If either value is dangerously low, use the Sit mode from the Action tab of your Character Status window to rest between combats.

Newbie Guide: When you reach Level 7, you will learn new magic. Seek instruction from the Magisters of the Shilen Temple. The Shilen Temple is the largest building in the village, located on the north side. You have probably noticed by now that when you defeat monsters you gain SP and experience. S…

links.text: Tell me more about learning magic.
Which magic should I learn first?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-m07-0.text: Newbie Guide: You can not simply sit down for a few days and learn magic. You must build your magical skills continuously, through the use of SP (skill points). For example, by now you may have learned Wind Strike up to Level 2. When you have saved 260 SP, you may then raise Wind Strike to Level 3.…

Newbie Guide: You may begin to learn spells at Level 7. I recommend that you begin by learning the Wind Strike spell to Level 2. If you have enough SP (skill points), you should raise it all the way to Level 3. If Wind Strike doesn't suit you for some reason, consider a Level 1 Ice Bolt . This spel…

Newbie Guide: There are many here in the village who could benefit from your services. Speak to them to find those who wish to offer employment. They will offer you an assignment when you click on Quest . They will not ask you to perform a quest which is beyond your abilities, so if they refuse to …

Have you already spoken to Abyssal Celebrant Undrias at the gate of the Shilen Temple? He may want to ask a favor of you. Also, seek out Sentry Nelsya at the no…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-m07.h.text: Newbie Guide: What do you wish to learn? The fundamental knowledge I can teach you is essential if you wish to be numbered among the great heroes of our race.

links.text: What is the best equipment for me?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: Now it is time to leave behind the village and its immediate surroundings, and explore the deep regions of the Dark Forest. Remember to visit Tetrarch Thifiell when you reach Level 10, and Blacksmith Karrod at Level 11. The quests they will assign you are of great importance to your d…

links.text: I want to hunt with others.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: I see. You have chosen a lonely and dangerous path, but it does have its own rewards. If you intend to hunt alone, there are things that you must know. First you must learn to time your battles wisely. As your level increases, you will find you need more and more rest between battles.…

Newbie Guide: It requires serious preparation to be an effective part of a group. Experience is the best teacher, but I can tell you some of the basics. First, for now it matters little whether you hunt with Fighters or with other Mystics. The most important thing right now is that you find people …

Newbie Guide: As soon as you save enough money, you should buy an Apprentice's Spellbook . Check the Chat and Trade windows regularly ... the best way to find quality items at a reasonable price is to buy them from other adventurers. When you reach Level 13 or 14 try to purchase a Cedar Staff . If …

links.text: I want to know about the characteristics of each weapon type.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: Weapons are classified into seven categories. They are: one-handed swords, blunt weapons, two-handed swords and two-handed blunt weapons, daggers, polearms, fists and bows. Your staff is considered a blunt weapon. I can offer you guidance about swords, blunt weapons, daggers and bows.

links.text: Difference between Mystic Weapons and Fighter Weapons

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: You've probably noticed that stores sell Mystic and Fighter weapons separately. Even if they seem to be of the same type, there are subtle differences. Fighter weapons cause heavy damage but possess low magic attack power, while with Mystic weapons the ratio is reversed. However, Figh…

Newbie Guide: One-handed swords are the most common weapons. They are well-balanced weapons in all their attributes. Mystics with a taste for hand-to-hand combat often carry swords and shields. This combination is particularly useful in solo play.

Newbie Guide: One-handed blunt weapons have a higher accuracy than other weapons. However, their chance to inflict critical damage is much lower. Blunt weapons are designed to reliably deal predictable amounts of damage . This is the reason they are the first weapons a Mystic learns. As you advance…

Newbie Guide: Two-handed blunt weapons and two-handed swords send a message of formidable power. Two-handed blunt weapons like the Cedar Staff -- a popular weapon among Mystics -- have a relatively slow swing, but can inflict damage nearly as well as a well-armed Fighter. They also have excellent r…

Newbie Guide: Dagger type weapons allow you to attack with unsurpassed speed. They also have the greatest chance of inflicting critical damage. Their accuracy is low, however, and of course their reach is quite short. Daggers also have a very small range of random damage.

Newbie Guide: Obviously, the advantage of bows is their ability to deliver damage at range. There is more, though, that you should know. Bows are the slowest weapons, but they can inflict the greatest damage. Most use their bows as a backup weapon, but with proper training a bow can become your pri…

Newbie Guide: What do you do with your old weapons when you buy new ones? Do you sell them to a store? You might receive a better price if you sell them to other players. Likewise, you can often buy gear for a better price from other players. Press the Trade tab on the bottom left of the Chat windo…

Newbie Guide: Take the equipment you have -- I hope it includes an Apprentice's Spellbook -- and travel south from the village to hunt Balor Orcs or walking fungi until you are ready for a better weapon. When you reach Level 9 or 10 and upgrade your weapon, go farther south to the Marshlands or the…

Newbie Guide: Your skills increase at a satisfactory rate. I can now tell you which skills you should improve first. Before I can advise you however, I must know whether you would rather concentrate your energies on fighting alone, or as a member of a party. Which is your choice?

Newbie Guide: When fighting in a party, your Fighters have the responsibility of fighting face to face with the enemy. You can hurl attack spells, but it is equally important for you to support your Fighters with healing and strengthening spells. To effectively support them, make sure you have Heal…

Newbie Guide: In solo play, you will need to do ever more damage as you advance in level. Therefore, it is important to regularly enhance the power of Wind Strike , which is your best attack spell. Defense is equally vital in solo play, so you should also learn Armor Mastery and Magic Defense . In …

Newbie Guide: Oh, hello! Have you completed your mission for Tetrarch Thifiell yet? It is very important that you complete this task. You should also see Blacksmith Karrod located at the western entrance of the village. I heard a rumor that he is recruiting volunteers for an Orc Subjugation quest, …

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-m14.h.text: Newbie Guide: My word, your progress so far has been most satisfactory. However, you have not yet been called upon to use your brain a great deal. From now on it will take wisdom and cunning to survive. In particular, you must make wise choices when it comes to your equipment and skills. Pay attent…

You may choose to be a Dark Wizard , practicing elemental magic, or you could become a Shillien Oracle , specializing in support magic. You should …

Newbie Guide: By level 16, if you have been fortunate you may have acquired an apprentice's staff . Even if luck has eluded you so far, you should have enough money to purchase one by level 18. If you are wearing Stockings of Devotion and a Tunic of Devotion at level 17, you are in excellent shape.…

Newbie Guide: Have you ever heard of an item called a spiritshot while you were hunting? Or have you ever wondered about what a spiritshot is while reading the detailed information about a weapon? It is an item that increases your magic attack. Directions for usage are identical to soulshots. While…

Newbie Guide: Through their arts, Dwarven craftsmen can crystallize certain substances into Leaguam, Ravi, Ciel and Arch, through a process they call the "Crystallization Ritual." These craftsmen have assigned grades to every substance in the world, according to the types of crystal they form durin…

Newbie Guide: By now, you should be able to hunt anywhere in the forest. I imagine that giant spiders and dark horrors are your primary targets. You can find many of these in the deep southern regions of the forest. Remember what I told you -- if travel time is becoming a nuisance, teleport through…

Newbie Guide: There are no more spells to be learned from the teachers of our village. When you have reached Level 20 and selected your profession, seek out the Human Magisters in that race's village of Gludin and the town of Gludio to learn new spells. If you become a Dark Wizard, you may be able …

Newbie Guide: Seek out Tetrarch Thallos as soon as you can. He is trying to free Hierarch Mitraell, but it has come to my attention that he does not yet possess all necessary materials. I'm sure he'll reward you for your assistance. If you're already hunting giant spiders, then you should certainly…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30600-m20.h.text: Newbie Guide: You have learned all you can from this forest. Now, your most pressing task is to choose your professional path. You may either become a Dark Wizard who masters elemental magic, or a Shillien Oracle who specializes in support magic.

At level 6, you can use the Apprentice Adventurer's Weapon Exch…
